context: Small multiples of daily energy consumption (kWh) across 12 months, with three years (2022-2024) overlaid as line charts sharing a common Y scale
first_impression: Well-structured small multiples with a shared Y axis enabling valid cross-panel comparison, using data-driven domain derivation via d3.extent.
what_works: Shared Y scale computed from global d3.extent(data) enables honest cross-panel comparison; line chart encoding correctly avoids zero-baseline requirement since variance is the focus.
what_doesnt: X scale is hardcoded to domain [1, 31] for all months, so February's axis shows a tick at 30 even though the line stops at day 28 — a minor visual honesty gap; line.defined() is absent, leaving the chart brittle if any real missing values were introduced.
